findings.description: _revision now rejects any value containing whitespace. Git accepts revision syntax with spaces, such as date-based reflog selectors like HEAD@{2 weeks ago}. Before this change those values were passed to git and worked. Now they raise ValueError, and the CLI exits with status 2 and a 'not a git revision' message. The check also rejects an empty until value, which previously meant since..HEAD.
findings.suggestion: Only reject values starting with '-' (the option-injection risk), and rely on the '--' separator and git's own error reporting for everything else. If empty values must be rejected, check only for emptiness.
findings.title: Revision validation rejects valid git revisions containing spaces
